The keyed option nevertheless offers greater capacity as an alternative remedy, and the justification broadens the premise to missing information OR representational capacity. Keep the remedy tied to adding relevant input information, or explicitly revise the premise to distinguish the two cases; do not promise capacity alone repairs missing measurements.
